messages:
nina: Heads-up  we need a single, concise hero for the launch that reads well for engineers and buying teams. Keep headline short (<12 words), put modes in the subhead, and make CTAs route correctly.

diego: Agreed. Draft headline: "Production LLM inference that scales with your needs". Subhead: "Start instantly with Hosted, reserve capacity with Dedicated, or deploy Private  same API, consistent ops."

rachel: UX: add three micro-CTAs under hero: Try hosted, Enterprise capacity, Benchmarks. Microcopy: Hosted -> "Start free; fast onboarding"; Dedicated -> "Reserved GPU pools & SLAs"; Private -> "VPC/on-prem + KMS".

omar: Routing plan: 
- Try hosted -> /signup?utm=hero_launch&mode=hosted -> Growth onboarding flow
- Enterprise capacity -> /contact-enterprise?utm=hero_launch&mode=enterprise -> AE + SE alert
- Benchmarks -> /benchmarks?utm=hero_launch&mode=benchmarks -> content funnel

nina: Webinar tie-in: 40-minute technical demo + Q&A titled "LLM serving in production: latency, cost, and fallbacks". Promo copy short: "Join our engineers for a playbook on serving LLMs. Wed May 6  register: <link>"

diego: Mini-bullets under pills (short): 
- "Smart caching and batching lowered per-token spend for customers while preserving latency SLOs."
- "Routing policies keep apps online during regional constraints."
- "Per-route observability helps teams tune cost vs. latency trade-offs."

rachel: Enterprise form fields: company, role, company size, expected peak qps, cloud provider, compliance needs, checkbox: "Request capacity planning call". Checkbox flags AE.

omar: UTMs standardized: /signup?utm_campaign=hero_launch&utm_mode=hosted, /contact?utm_campaign=hero_launch&utm_mode=enterprise, /events/serve-llms?utm_campaign=webinar_hero

copybot: Reminder: "Hero copy sprint - launch week" tomorrow 10:00 PT. :bell:

nina: Great. I'll assemble A/B headline variants and hand off to Figma. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
